blue_marble_scope: NASA Blue Marble shaded relief and bathymetry static composite. Not current cloud cover or a spacecraft frame.
epic_scope: Actual EPIC photograph from NOAA DSCOVR; not the selected LEO satellite.
high_resolution_scope: Deferred 8192×4096 NASA basemap for the close satellite view; downsampled for narrow screens or hardware texture limits. Static composite, not live imagery.
active_surface: NASA Earth Observatory / July 2004 Blue Marble Next Generation. 4096px downloaded; 2048px startup derivative. The shaded-bathymetry images are retained legacy artifacts and no longer used.
first_person_clouds: Optional date-specific MODIS Terra daily composite through /api/surface. Not real-time weather; gaps use static base.
